# Goodwin University

> Career-focused university in Connecticut offering degree programs in nursing, healthcare, business, and advanced manufacturing with flexible scheduling and comprehensive student support.

Goodwin University is a Connecticut-based institution serving prospective, current, and former students through multiple schools including Nursing and Health Professions, Business, Technology and Advanced Manufacturing, and Applied Liberal Arts and Social Sciences. The university emphasizes career preparation, workforce partnerships, and accessible pathways including transfer options, early college programs, and graduate degrees.

## Key Topics

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [Admissions](https://www.goodwin.edu/admissions): Main admissions page covering enrollment process, financial aid, and degree program pathways.
- [Degree Programs in CT](https://www.goodwin.edu/majors): Comprehensive listing of degree and certificate programs across nursing, healthcare, business, and manufacturing.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://www.goodwin.edu/admissions/masters-programs): Graduate program admissions including Family Nurse Practitioner, PMHNP, and Master of Education.
- [Transferring to Goodwin University](https://www.goodwin.edu/transfer-students): Transfer student admissions process with credit transfer information and flexible scheduling options.
- [Early College Programs in CT](https://www.goodwin.edu/early-college): Dual enrollment program for high school students to earn college credits before graduation.
- [Schedule a Tour](https://www.goodwin.edu/video-tour): Virtual and in-person campus tour scheduling for East Hartford, Connecticut location.

## Financial Aid & Affordability

- [Financial Aid in CT](https://www.goodwin.edu/financial-aid): Financial aid overview covering FAFSA, grants, scholarships, loans, and personalized aid planning.
- [Tuition](https://www.goodwin.edu/admissions/tuition-information): Tuition costs, financial aid options, and affordability information for Goodwin programs.
- [Learn More](https://www.goodwin.edu/landingpages/learn-more-web): Enrollment inquiry landing page featuring student support services and financial aid information.

## Current Student Resources

- [Current Students](https://www.goodwin.edu/current-students): Portal providing current students access to myNavigator, registration, advising, and career services resources.
- [Welcome Newly Enrolled Students](https://www.goodwin.edu/new-students): Onboarding guide for newly enrolled students with checklist, FAQs, and getting started resources.
- [Academics](https://www.goodwin.edu/academics): Academic overview with departments, library resources, registrar services, and support centers.
- [2025-26 Academic Calendar](https://www.goodwin.edu/academics/calendar): Academic calendar with semester dates, holidays, registration deadlines, and withdrawal dates.

## Faculty, Staff & Community

- [Faculty & Staff](https://www.goodwin.edu/faculty-staff): Portal for faculty and staff with access to myNavigator, SharePoint, Paycom, and IT resources.
- [Alumni Association](https://www.goodwin.edu/alumni): Alumni Association membership page with events, volunteering, scholarships, and community engagement.
- [Employers](https://www.goodwin.edu/employers): Employer partnerships page highlighting workforce training and curriculum development in Connecticut.

## Academic Advising & Support

- [Advising for Prospective Students](https://www.goodwin.edu/academic-advising/prospective-students): Applicant advisor services for academic planning and course selection guidance.
- [Nursing Information Sessions in CT](https://www.goodwin.edu/landingpages/sessions): Virtual on-demand nursing information session for prospective RN and associate degree students.

## Home & Overview

- [Career Focused University in CT | Goodwin University](https://www.goodwin.edu): Goodwin University homepage showcasing career-focused degrees in nursing, healthcare, business, and manufacturing.
